verdict.rationale: 1Password's Events API and Connect API references use the Mintlify interactive playground, with a "Try it" panel beside each endpoint and generated cURL samples. Both are rendered from downloadable OpenAPI specs. That is first-party, runnable, interactive reference for those surfaces. However, the CLI and SDK docs are prose and code only, so coverage is limited to two API surfaces. missing for 10: interactive/runnable reference for the Service Accounts, CLI and SDK surfaces; independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Events API and Connect API references run the Mintlify interactive playground ("Try it" renders next to the endpoint, e.g. POST /api/v2/auditevents, with generated cURL samples).
1Password publishes the Events API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (semver 1.4.1), linked from the Events API reference
The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1), linked from the Connect API reference as the specification file.
